== Title ==
<span lang="ja">レクテナ（整流アンテナ）</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">1フォースを使用して任意の宇宙船に配備する。相手が同じ星系で戦闘を宣言した場合、“リアクション”としてその星系にカードを配備することができる（フォースは通常通りに支払う）。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ファブリテック社製通信／センサー・ユニット。受動／能動型のスキャナー、高出力妨害システム、船間通信機および短距離索敵装置としての機能を持つ。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Rectenna]].

'''Lore''' — A Fabritech-made communications and sensor unit. It functions as a passive/active scanner, high-output jamming system, ship-to-ship communicator, and short-range search device.

'''Game text''' — Use 1 Force to deploy on any starship. If the opponent declared a battle at the same system, you may deploy cards to that system as a react. Force is paid as usual.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese lore lists passive/active scanners and a short-range search device. English lists active/passive scanners and a short-range target acquisition program. Japanese says the opponent declared a battle, without “just.”<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-rectenna-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Rectenna]].</ref>
